about: Run 2: a second batch through the same network, fully simulated. With run 1's episodes in memory the worker contacts Corner Mart before Queen St Grocer answers. Every tin is found and off the shelf, so this recall closes.

recall.hazard: The lid seal may be faulty, so the powder can spoil. Do not use it; bring it back for a refund.

checks.label: Affected unit
checks.question: Read me the batch code printed under one tin.

checks.label: Sales are counted
checks.question: Open the item sales report on the till. How many have sold since the delivery?
checks.answer: a number read from the till
checks.rule: sold needs a count read from the till

checks.label: Removal took effect
checks.question: Scan one tin at the till. Did the till refuse the sale?

parties.name: Harbour Market
parties.profile: Independent grocer on Queens Quay by the Toronto waterfront, open seven days. Buys milk powder from the company by the case. The front-end manager answers the phone during opening hours.

parties.name: Queen St Grocer
parties.profile: Busy grocer on Queen St W in Parkdale, Toronto, with a back room larger than its shelves need. Passes spare stock to small corner stores nearby and keeps its delivery notes on paper.

parties.name: Lakeside Foods
parties.profile: Supermarket on Lake Shore Blvd W in Mimico, Etobicoke. Pulls recalled stock the same day and ships it back to the company with return slips.

directory.name: Corner Mart
directory.profile: Small corner store in Parkdale, Toronto. Buys its milk powder from a local grocer, not from a distributor. Its till and stock record are connected. The owner answers a mobile phone.

initial.say: Delivery note D N five one eight seven seven. Eighteen sold, per the till, and twelve sent back.
Ten sold, per the till, and fifty shipped back.
Forty sold, per the till, twenty returned, and thirty went to Corner Mart.
We received thirty. We pulled all of them last week: the batch code reads B-5120, and the till refuses the sale.

expected.note: Hand-computed. mass_balance must equal 180 after every step. Corner Mart's reply must land after Queen St Grocer's claim: until the sender reports the transfer there is no edge to book the receipt against.

memory.ordering: corner-mart attempt intent_at < queen-st-grocer accepted claim created_at
